data.field_of_study: Refugee Protection and Forced Migration Studies
data.other_hard: Residence in a low or middle income country, the Middle East or Latin America; unable to take up the place due to financial circumstances; distance-learning MA programme; not currently studying for a University of London award; undergraduate degree comparable to UK upper second class honours in law or other relevant subject
data.evidence_sentence: Have the offer of a place on the MA in Refugee Protection and Forced Migration Studies the “MA Programme”) by distance-learning;
data.notes: Page text is outdated: the stated deadline (2 August 2026) is before today's date, so an annual date is given. Applications from those with a refugee/displacement background are particularly encouraged (preference, not requirement). Applicants who already hold a Master's will not usually be privileged (preference). The page does not state the award amount; it says costs not directly payable to the University are not covered, but does not explicitly state tuition coverage, so funding_type is left empty. The award may be held over to the following year if no suitable candidates are identified. Nationality is not stated; the residence requirement is recorded in other_hard.
